name: ianhobbs-kirby-swiper-block
description: Kirby CMS layout block plugin — Swiper 12 carousel with panel editor

scripts.swiper:update: V=${SWIPER_VERSION:-12.2.0}; for f in swiper-bundle.min.css swiper-bundle.min.js; do curl -sfL -o assets/vendor/swiper/$f https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swiper@$V/$f || exit 1; done; curl -sfL -o assets/vendor/swiper/LICENSE https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nolimits4web/swiper/v$V/LICENSE
